Packing List Generator

Generate a smart travel packing checklist by trip type and length — quantities scale with your days and travelers, then check items off.

–
Items
–

📖 How to use

  1. Choose your trip type, length in days and number of travelers.
  2. Tick the categories you want included.
  3. Generate the list, check items off as you pack, and download it for offline use.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it adapt to the trip type?

Yes — pick Beach, Business, City break, Camping, Skiing, Backpacking, Cruise or Road trip and the base list adapts with trip-specific gear.

How are quantities calculated?

Clothing quantities are computed from your trip length (e.g. one shirt per day plus a spare), and most shared items scale with the traveler count.

Can I check items off?

Check items off as you pack; your checklist state stays on this page while it is open.

Is my trip data private?

Fully private — everything is generated and stored only in your browser.
